verdict.rationale: Aider is designed as a single-session CLI pair-programming tool driven interactively or via one-shot scripting (--message, coder.run); there is no evidence of orchestrating multiple parallel autonomous agents running for hours/days. Community mentions a third-party experimental 'navigator-mode' for autonomy, but this is not fleet/parallel multi-agent orchestration and is explicitly noted as costly/experimental, not a documented fleet-management capability.
